subject: french
title: Polite Phrases
welcome_lead: Please, thank you and excuse me.
meta_desc: KS3 French: politeness, please, thanks, sorry.

walkthroughs.body_html: French has two forms. S'il te plait (informal) for friends. S'il vous plait (formal) for teachers, strangers, anyone older.
Merci = thanks. Merci beaucoup = thanks a lot. To reply, say de rien (it's nothing) or je vous en prie (you're welcome — formal).
Use pardon if you bump someone or want to get past. Excusez-moi is more formal — 'excuse me' to get attention.
